company_news.headline: Why Delta and United’s Loyalty Programs Could Be Worth $30 Billion

Based on the valuation of the Aeroplan stake, the Delta SkyMiles and United MileagePlus loyalty programs could each be worth $30 billion or more, which would be a significant chunk of each airline’s market values, Jefferies analyst Sheila Kahyaoglu wrote after the sale.
